forcing: Copernicus SMOC currents + ERA5 wind, 2025-06-01 to 2025-09-30

site._note: Site settings. Measure the gap with: python -m qandeel.measure_gap --a 'lat, lon' --b 'lat, lon' (see README).
site._latlon_note: Approximate public location of the plant; the data point used for currents is offset ~5 km offshore.
site.gap_depth_source: Public marine-works description of the Barakah intake channel: dredged to -5.5 to -9.5 m MSL; deepest value used (not a survey).

wind_drift_sensitivity.best_release: 3 km at 45 deg, 5 h tow, 60% return
3 km at 45 deg, 6 h tow, 58% return
15 km at 75 deg, 21 h tow, 2% return

capex_items.item: Bubble curtain: diffuser pipe, flotation hose, anchors (300 m, installed)
Oil-free variable-speed compressor ~150 kW, standby unit, air line
Ocean containment boom 300 m with 2 m skirt
Closed-bottom retention bags (2) and quick-release ends
Two uncrewed surface vessels (USVs) with tow gear, shore-supervised
Gap camera, pressure sensors, control PLC, software

opex_items.item: Two shore-supervised operators on call through the bloom season (share of existing staff)
Diver/ROV inspection and diffuser cleaning (warm-water fouling), 4-6 visits
Compressor service, boom and bag repair, spares
